audit.whatIsWrong: report[14].t quoted 47.92% WR; the packet says 59.43% over 106 games.
audit.why: The figure was not just stale, it pointed the opposite way — a reader would conclude Yi loses this matchup on average.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer's whys are shifted one row against their labels: whys[4] (the Level 6 row) talks about a level-5 Wuju spike, and whys[5] (the First item row) talks about level 6.
audit.why: Rows 4 and 5 are Level 6 and First item. The full layer's phases[4]/phases[5] are correct; only the content whys drifted, so the two layers described different levels.
audit.corrected: whys[4] and whys[5] re-anchored to Level 6 and First item. The chart sides themselves are correct and unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: Slicing Maelstrom is described as 'a long cooldown' with no number.
audit.why: It is 120s flat at every rank. A spent ult gives Yi two full minutes of free all-in windows — that is the concrete version of the advice the page was gesturing at.
audit.corrected: 120s written into breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[1].text and content.mid; Highlander's 85s into phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two places credit Kennen with a W slow and say Highlander's slow immunity answers it. Kennen has no slow anywhere in his kit — Electrical Surge damages and applies a Mark of the Storm; Lightning Rush gives HIM move speed. Separately, spikes[1].text and content.mid tell you to Meditate through his ult, which is backwards: Mark of the Storm's stun cancels the channel.
audit.why: Riot's text for W is damage plus a mark, with no movement effect; E grants Kennen move speed entering and attack speed leaving. Meditate is flagged as an interruptible channel, so any of his three-mark stuns ends it and wastes the mana.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and report[5].t rewritten — the reason Highlander sticks to him is raw move speed, not slow immunity. Meditate-cancel written into report[5].t, spikes[1].text and content.mid. Electrical Surge noted as applying on-hit, so his damage scales with attack speed.

audit.why: The punishable window is correctly identified as Slicing Maelstrom; it only lacked the number, now added. Thundering Shuriken drops to a 4s cooldown at rank 5, so his poke is not a window to wait out.

edits.before: Highlander's move speed and slow immunity let you stick to him through his W slow, and you can Alpha Strike the moment he commits Slicing Maelstrom.
edits.after: Highlander's 85s of move speed closes on a champion with no slow anywhere in his kit, and Alpha Strike goes untargetable the moment he commits Slicing Maelstrom.

edits.before: Track his R (Slicing Maelstrom) above everything — it's a long cooldown, and once it's down you have a free window to all-in him with no stun-lock answer.
edits.after: Track Slicing Maelstrom (R) above everything — 120s flat, so one spent ult hands you two clear minutes to all-in him with no stun-lock left to answer you.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetability is your one answer to his Slicing Maelstrom — blink during his R cast to avoid the stun-lock. Meditate out-sustains his Q/W poke between trades, and Highlander's slow immunity ignores his W slow to let you stick to him.
edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetability is your one answer to Slicing Maelstrom — blink during the cast to avoid the stun-lock. Kennen carries no slow at all, so Highlander's raw speed catches him; and never Meditate while he holds marks, because the stun cancels the channel outright.

edits.before: TRICKY (47.92% WR) — Kennen out-ranges and out-CCs you early, but bait his R, survive to your on-hit spike, and the 2+ item window is firmly yours.
edits.after: TRICKY (59.43% WR) — Kennen out-ranges and out-CCs you early, but bait his R, survive to your on-hit spike, and the 2+ item window is firmly yours.

edits.before: Your level-5 Wuju spike flips the isolated duel.
edits.after: Highlander's speed flips the duel at level 6.

edits.before: At 6 his ult stun-lock keeps it skill-based.
edits.after: Your first item against his ult keeps it even.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom is a big AoE stun-DPS ult, but one-on-one you can Alpha-Strike a shuriken and Meditate through it; this is where your Wuju spike flips the duel.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is a 120s AoE stun, but one-on-one Alpha Strike takes you untargetable through the cast; never Meditate under it, because his stun cancels the channel.

edits.before: By level 5 your Wuju Style true damage flips the isolated duel; at 6 respect Slicing Maelstrom but you can Meditate and Q through it to win one-on-one.
edits.after: By level 6 Highlander's speed flips the isolated duel; respect Slicing Maelstrom on its 120s, and never Meditate on marks — his stun cancels the channel.

notes: Kennen has no slow in his kit; the page invented a 'W slow' twice and built the Highlander advice on it. Also reversed the Meditate advice — the page told you to channel through his ult, which his three-mark stun cancels. Win rate was printed as 47.92% against a packet value of 59.43%, i.e. the wrong side of even. Content whys[4]/whys[5] were off by one row against their labels.
